notes.title: Witchdoctor
notes.notes:
We are pleased to present the first large-scale update of the game Dungeons and Vampires!

There:
[list]
[*] fixed a significant part of the bugs that the players wrote in the discussions
[*] added a new character Witchdoctor, with his unique abilities
[*] new game mechanics - traps right on the floors
[*] monsters can see their HP
[/ list]

notes.title: Developer's group
notes.notes:
Hi guys. We remind you that we have a group in the steam, where we sometimes plan to hold various competitions.
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/angrygames_ru/

Who has not entered - cleans the dungeons from the remains of monsters. Mop take at the entrance.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Well, has everyone sharpened aspen stakes and made torches?
The door to the vault with a vampire opens right now!
Come in and find a bloodsucker, hammer a stake into his cold heart, and go look for the next one!
